subject: Evaluation request: inference vendor replacement and commercial fit
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma@skyline.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Skyline Procurement <procurement@skyline.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluating replacement vendors for inference (Skyline)

Hi Avery,

We are running an RFP as part of a platform refresh and are considering replacing our current inference provider (AltAI). We saw Redwood mentioned by a couple of engineering leads and would like to understand fit for our production requirements: low-latency chat, multi-region inference, and on-prem options for certain regulated models.

Attached is our RFP summary and the baseline performance/KPI expectations (Skyline_RFP_Q3.pdf). Key items for us: predictable token costs for high-concurrency endpoints, KV cache behavior, and an enterprise SLA for uptime and incident response.

Can we set up a short call this week for discovery? Also please share any ballpark licensing/packaging options you’d propose for a 3–5M token/month profile with occasional burst to dedicated capacity.

Thanks,
Emma Clarke
Director, Platform Engineering
Skyline AI

Attachments: Skyline_RFP_Q3.pdf
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@skyline.ai>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluating replacement vendors for inference (Skyline)

Hi Emma — great to hear from you and thanks for the RFP. I’m available Thursday or Friday for a 30-minute discovery to cover the items you called out.

Quick notes before the call:
- We can support 3–5M tokens/month via hosted API with burst to Dedicated pools for peak windows. We also offer Private (VPC/on-prem) for the regulated models you mentioned.
- Typical levers: reserved committed capacity (reduces unit cost), intelligent KV caching (reduces billed tokens), and model quantization profiles for CPU or mixed-GPU footprints.

I’m attaching a short pricing/template we use to map costs to traffic patterns — if you can fill the traffic mix and peak concurrency rows it’ll help us put together a tailored comparison (pricing_comparison.xlsx).

Proposed next steps:
1) Discovery call to validate traffic and constraints (30 min).
2) We’ll produce a side-by-side econ comparison (Redwood vs AltAI) and a recommended rollout (pilot -> Dedicated -> Private).
3) If it looks good we can follow with a short-term price-match/counteroffer for the pilot window.

Calendar links: https://outlook.office.com/meeting/avery/redwood-skyline-discovery

Would Thursday 10:30am PT work?

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: pricing_comparison.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Evaluating replacement vendors for inference (Skyline)

Avery — looped in Connor (solutions) and Priyom (commercial). I reviewed the RFP. High level thoughts for a differentiated response:

1) Pricing approach: propose a 6-month starter commitment with an effective per-token parity to AltAI for baseline volumes, then step down to our standard committed rate. Include a pilot credit bucket to offset migration costs (onboarding & benchmark credits).

2) Packaging: deliver hosted API for immediate cutover, Dedicated burst for predictable peaks, and a scoped Private delivery plan for the regulated models (3-month on-prem pilot).

3) Ops & SLA: include a 99.95% regional SLA for hosted endpoints, a named escalation engineer for go-live, and a 24/7 incident pager for first 30 days post cutover.

Connor — can you validate the feasibility of a 3-month on-prem pilot and an SRE-assisted migration window? Priyom — can you draft a headline commercial that matches AltAI list pricing for the first 6 months and shows the blended ARR impact?

I attached a populated pricing sheet with our starting anchors (pricing_comparison.xlsx).

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_comparison.xlsx
From: Skyline Procurement <procurement@skyline.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Clarke <emma@skyline.ai>, sales@altai.com
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2026 07:33:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Evaluating replacement vendors for inference (Skyline)

Hi Avery/Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround. We received a separate counter from AltAI this morning; I’ve attached the redline of their commercial offer for reference (AltAI_current_offer.pdf). Summary of AltAI’s key concessions: short-term pilot credits, a 10% discount on published unit pricing for year one, and an escrowed performance holdback tied to latency SLOs.

Requirements from Skyline:
- We need price parity against AltAI’s Year 1 effective unit cost for comparable volumes.
- On-prem edge deployment must be certified for our regulated models within 60 days of pilot start.
- Contract must include a three-month rollback window without exit penalties.

If you can match parity + commit to the 60-day pilot certification and a rollback term, Procurement will push Skyline execs to approve a pilot. Otherwise we’ll proceed with AltAI.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Skyline AI

Attachments: AltAI_current_offer.pdf
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@skyline.ai>, procurement@skyline.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Evaluating replacement vendors for inference (Skyline)

Emma / Procurement — thanks for the clarity and the AltAI packet. We can match the Year 1 effective unit cost for the baseline volume you shared with one conditional ask: a 6-month pilot commitment to validate performance and SLOs. Proposed commercial and operational package: 

- Pricing: match AltAI Year 1 effective unit price for the baseline tokens with a 6-month term. After month 6, revert to our committed Dedicated rate (we’ll show blended economics in the final term sheet).
- Credits: $40k migration/onboarding credit for benchmarks, model tuning, and runbook handover.
- On-prem pilot: scoped 60-day certification window with a named delivery engineer and weekly checkpoints (Connor to lead).
- SLA & rollback: 99.95% regional SLA with a 3-month rollback window and limited exit charge equal to 10% of remaining pilot term (we are willing to cap this if procurement insists on no penalty; request to narrow to reduce legal turnaround).
- Escrow/perf protection: we propose a small performance credit tied to latency SLO failures rather than escrowed funds to keep contracting simple.

Next steps:
1) Priyom will produce a one-page headline term summary and the blended ARR impact by EOD Wednesday.
2) I’ll circulate a short term summary (Redwood_Skyline_Term_Summary.pdf) and a DocuSign link for pilot acceptance if this is acceptable.
3) Connor will schedule the pre-onboard technical kickoff once the term is signed.

If this matches the ask we should be able to get Procurement sign-off and have the pilot start in ~2 weeks.

Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: Redwood_Skyline_Term_Summary.pdf
